devdoc.details: The registry admin can only enable/disable collections. It cannot move assets,      change offers, charge a fee, pause unrelated collections, or upgrade this contract.

setCollection(address,bool).details: Disabling prevents new offers and fills involving the collection. It never moves an NFT.

devdoc.title: SqueekSwap V2

create((address,address,uint64,uint64,(a.notice: Creates an offer while every NFT remains in its current owner's wallet.

fill(uint256,(address,address,uint64,uin.notice: Atomically exchanges every exact `(collection, tokenId)` pair in the offer.

reclaim(uint256).notice: Anyone may close an expired offer so indexers can stop presenting it as live.

revokeAll().notice: Invalidates every currently open offer made by the caller in one transaction.

setCollection(address,bool).notice: Enables or disables a standards-compliant ERC-721 collection.

setCollections(address[],bool).notice: Applies one support state to several collections in one admin transaction.

transferRegistryAdmin(address).notice: Starts a two-step registry-admin transfer. The new admin must accept.

userdoc.notice: Non-custodial atomic ERC-721 barter across admin-approved collections.
